chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Shaving it is better than plucking it, and applying depilatory paste is better than shaving it."

key_terms.حَلْقُهُ: shaving it; removing the hair by shaving
key_terms.طَلْيُهُ: applying depilatory paste to it; using a removal ointment
key_terms.نَتْفِهِ: plucking it; removing the hair by pulling

ai.seo_question: Which method of unwanted hair removal is considered better in this hadith from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states a preference among methods of removing unwanted hair. The hadith indicates that shaving is preferable to plucking, and that using depilatory paste is preferable to shaving, reflecting guidance on cleanliness and bodily care.
